title: Acquire workspace isolation through a host provider seam
narrative: Nubble asks branches for isolation without hard-coding worktrees or containers — the host provider supplies the mechanism. Accepts WalkingLabs L13 and Codex guidance[^wl-l13-workspace][^wl-codex-workspace].
implementation: `WorkspaceIsolationProvider` and `InMemoryWorkspaceIsolationProvider` in `mechaharness.workspace_isolation` define the acquire/release capability seam.
